title: IR_OCR combined report_result.json
description: One file per document: <output>/<document_id>/report_result.json. A derived export; the OCR database stays the source of truth. The OCR payload is embedded exactly as GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/results returns it (with its own schema_version); it is null when OCR has produced nothing. Each pipeline's status stands on its own. Paths are relative to the document's folder <output>/<uploaded file name>_<ext>/; image bytes are never embedded.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS envelope (not of the OCR payload).

generated_at.description: UTC, when this file was last rebuilt

ocr_document_status.description: the application's own document status (queued, processing, completed, failed, verified)

ocr_extraction_status.description: results.extraction_status of the OCR payload (complete, partial, failed)

image_extraction_status.description: status of the LATEST image run

payload.description: ResultsResponse: document, results (fields, provenance, validation, review state, standard_ir ...), field_corrections

run_id.description: the run whose images are listed (newest usable run)

skipped_images.description: images found that do not show a person

file.description: relative to the document's folder, e.g. person_images/<file name> image.jpeg or person_images/rerun_2/<file name> image (2).jpeg

source_page.description: PDF page; null for DOCX / XLSX

source_member.description: name of the embedded image in the source file
